heading.es: Prueba Beta — El Reporte del Estrés 🌊🔔

body.en:
ALRIGHT BITCHES, THIS SHIT'S LIVE! 🌊🔔

It's been a stressful fucking day. I've already managed to piss off my wife, but I know she still loves me. 😂❤️

Once y'all start arriving, Bri will finally have enough backup to outnumber me. We can put this chaos behind us and start having some FUCKING FUN!

We're almost there, people. I love you guys. 🌊

If you got this, drop a 🌊 in the chat.

— Jon
body.es:
¡A VER, CABRONES, ESTA MADRE YA ESTÁ EN VIVO! 🌊🔔

Ha sido un pinche día estresante. Ya hasta hice enojar a mi esposa, ¡pero sé que todavía me quiere! 😂❤️

En cuanto empiecen a llegar, Bri va a tener refuerzos para hacerme montón. Vamos a dejar todo este desmadre atrás y ¡POR FIN EMPEZAR A PASÁRNOSLA DE POCA MADRE!

Ya casi, mi gente. Los quiero mucho. 🌊

Si les llegó, manden una 🌊 al chat.

— Jon

notes: Independent from original 2026-10-13 daily beta and from 31 scheduled wedding pushes. Host must unlock and explicitly confirm; no automatic send. Original public history entry beta-2026-10-13 was removed at owner's request while keeping original provider receipt as a private audit record.
